Maya Chen: Hey folks — first week! My monitor keeps losing signal when I unplug and replug the laptop into the dock. Also Wi-Fi drops for a few seconds during video calls. Anyone seen this before?
Ravi (IT): Welcome Maya! Two quick Qs: 1) Is the dock RD-DK2 that came in the kit? 2) When Wi-Fi drops, do other devices on the same network also drop?
Maya Chen: Yes RD-DK2. Other devices (phone) stay connected when my laptop drops. Happens mostly after I wake from sleep or when I unplug the power.
Ravi (IT): Sounds like a USB power negotiation issue. Can you check System Preferences > Energy Saver and disable 'Wake for network access'? Also try: System Settings > Displays > hold Option and click Detect Displays after reconnect. If that doesn't help I can open a ticket and ship a replacement cable/dock.
Maya Chen: Tried Detect Displays, still intermittent. Disabled Wake for network access but saw the drop again during a quick Zoom.
it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket created: HDK-4102 for Maya Chen — Dock connection + intermittent Wi-Fi. Status: Open. Assigned: Ravi (IT). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HDK-4102
Alex (ShipOps): We have an alternative shielded USB-C cable and a different RD-DK3 dock in stock. Can ship today if Maya confirms address.
Maya Chen: Address: 221 Maple St, Unit 2, San Mateo, CA 94401. Please send both.
Priyanka (Manager): @Maya thanks for flagging — LMK if you need a loaner docking station from our office too.
Maya Chen: Got the RD-DK3 and new cable today. Swapped them and ran two hours of calls + some screen sharing — no disconnects so far. Thanks everyone!
Ravi (IT): Great — I'll mark HDK-4102 pending verification for 24h. If you don't see any more drops we'll resolve it. Ping me if it recurs. :thumbsup:
it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket HDK-4102 status changed to Resolved by Ravi (IT) at 1880123478.
